The execution failed because rows 46 and 47 (25th and 75th percentiles) returned '#NAME?' errors. This indicates that the spreadsheet engine (or the test environment's evaluator) did not recognize the formula used. The trace shows: 'H46: expected -1.6531688150158277, got #NAME?'. 

This typically happens when using `PERCENTILE.INC` or `PERCENTILE.EXC` in an environment that only supports the legacy `PERCENTILE` function, or vice versa. The Planner should check which specific percentile function is compatible or simply use the base `PERCENTILE(range, k)` function which has the broadest compatibility in Excel-like environments.
